name: Queen's Gambit
description: A classic queen-pawn opening where White offers the c-pawn to challenge Black's center.

moves.explanation: White controls the center and prepares queenside play.
White asks Black's d-pawn a question and fights for more central control.

ideas: Use the c-pawn to pressure Black's d5 pawn.
Develop naturally with Nc3, Nf3, and Bg5 or e3.
If Black captures on c4, try to win the pawn back with development.
commonMistakes: Trying to win material before finishing development.
Letting Black keep the c4 pawn for free.
Moving the queen early instead of developing pieces.
